title: Gosh's Veneration
html:
Gosh's Veneration
Piece:  Boots
Class:  Fighter
Defense Rating:  varies with item level

Gosh's Veneration are fighter boots.

This item is soulbound.

This is part of the later dedicated fighter class set. It does not enter the shared drop pool until 35. The bands are on Rainbow Level Bands.

Attributes:

The name and the look are fixed. The joke ending is one of the fighter armor suffixes. That ending is what sets Strength / Agility / Endurance.

The rest of the stats roll and do not show up in the name.

  • Resists: a random pair or triple from divine, fire, ice, poison, and shadow.

It is unknown how many different varieties exist. The same ending can still drop with different rolls underneath.

The base item always carries:

  • + Divine Damage
  • + % Melee Attack Speed
  • + % Melee Critical Chance

Rolled copies can also pick up an extra ending. Those endings and their bonuses are listed on Mythic Suffixes.
